relationships.subject: p66Shc
relationships.evidence_quote: knockdown of p66Shc significantly inhibited ROS production and NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome activation, which were reversed by a ROS donor (t-BOOH)

relationships.subject: p66Shc
relationships.evidence_quote: Spinal p66shc may facilitate the development of inflammatory pain by promoting the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome through ROS.

key_findings: Spinal p66Shc rises in CFA inflammatory pain and its knockdown attenuates hyperalgesia.
p66Shc knockdown reduces ROS and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, reversed by t-BOOH; nigericin reverses the analgesia.
